# `aitbc wallet transactions`

List recent blockchain transactions for the active or named wallet.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc wallet transactions [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--name` | text | — | no | Wallet name. |
| `--limit` | integer | `10` | no | Number of transactions to show |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc wallet transactions
```
